description.en: A 3D plush-cute pet park: booking, walk-buddy, check-ins, pet profiles with tri-ring stats, a four-zone park map with reservations, community feed and membership — pixar-fluffy renders on clay-candy materials with soft idle motion.
description.zh: 3D 萌宠质感乐园：预约/遛伴/打卡、萌宠档案三环状态、园区四分区地图与预约、社区 feed 与会员卡——皮克斯式蓬松渲染+粘土糖果材质+软影微动。
